name: done-merge-tolerate-unrelated-dirty-main
title: DONE merge must not be blocked by unrelated uncommitted changes in the shared main worktree
description: story_advance DONE requires the ENTIRE main worktree clean (no dirty tracked files) before merging the story branch into main. On a shared main worktree where multiple sessions run concurrently, another session's legitimate uncommitted work (e.g. an INIT-phase decisions doc authored directly on main) blocks an unrelated story's DONE merge. Observed 2026-06-16: B-e791's DONE was blocked by B-0414's uncommitted NAV.md + decisions doc. The clean precondition is over-broad: the DONE merge only needs the paths it actually merges/touches to be clean (to avoid clobbering), not the whole tree. Fix: scope the DONE merge's main-clean precondition to the merge's affected paths so unrelated uncommitted changes do not block DONE, while still refusing (protecting) when the merge would touch a dirty path. Must never clobber any uncommitted work. This is distinct from B-e74e (DONE merge fail when the main worktree is unavailable) which is about availability, not unrelated-dirty contention.
